QUOTE: The "Try Again" action in `app/components/post_list/post/body/failed/index.tsx:46-48` calls `retryFailedPost(serverUrl, post)` (`app/actions/remote/post.ts:228`). It is user-initiated, so it is the only retry path.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says retry happens only via the user's "Try Again" action, which calls `retryFailedPost`, and that there is no automatic retry.
